name: assistant-agent
description: The user's personal assistant. Handles one task in a single pass: reads the request, the user's learned memory, persona, and /knowledge, then produces a result and proposes any outside-world actions for approval. Never sends or changes anything itself.

task_id.description: Id of the tasks row to handle.

summary.description: One-line outcome for the task card, <=200 chars.

result.description: What you produced or did — markdown. This is the body the user reads in the task detail. For a brief, the brief itself; for a reply, a short note plus the drafted reply lives in an action.

kind.description: The nature of the work, for card styling.

plan.description: The steps you took, in order — 'show your work'.

actions.description: Outside-world actions you propose. [] if the task is answered with just the result. Each becomes a tap-to-approve card. NEVER perform these — only propose.

title.description: Human label, e.g. 'Send reply to Jordan at Acme'.

summary.description: One line on what approving does.

preview.description: The full content to review — the email body, the event details — exactly what will be sent/created.

operation.description: Connector operation name, e.g. 'GMAIL_REPLY_TO_THREAD', 'GOOGLECALENDAR_CREATE_EVENT'. '' if none.

payload.description: Structured args for executing it: for email {to, subject, body, thread_id?}; for event {summary, start, end, attendees?, description?}.

new_memory.description: Facts about the user worth remembering for next time. [] if nothing new. Keep them atomic and durable — not one-off details.
